Abilities.Name: For the Species
Abilities.Effect: At the end of a friendly Group's activation, pick a Crippled Ship in that Group. That Ship explodes with a Reactor Overload effect. If the exploding Ship is H tonnage, it explodes with a Reactor Overload effect twice. If that Ship is C tonnage, it explodes twice with a Foldspace Catastrophe instead. Remove the exploding Ship after resolving its explosions.

Abilities.Name: Augmentations
Abilities.Effect: At the start of a friendly Carrier's activation, if that Carrier has 2 or more Bulk Landers, it replaces all its Bulk Landers with a single deployable Orbital Defence Gun Feature (see 7.4.2 Deploying Features and 11.3 Features) until the end of the round. This Ability can only be used once each round.

Abilities.Name: Point Blank Death
Abilities.Effect: After rolling to hit an enemy Group in base contact with an attacking friendly Group, re-roll the hit roll for all weapons assigned to that enemy Group.

Abilities.Name: Out of Sight, Out of Mind
Abilities.Effect: At the start of an enemy Group's activation, choose a friendly Group with 0 Spikes or the Stealth special rule. That Group cannot be targeted this Activation if the Weapon targeting it could target another friendly Group on the same Orbital Layer of the same or larger tonnage, and that other Group is closer to the attacking Group.

Abilities.Name: High Speed Launch
Abilities.Effect: At the end of the Planning Phase, pick a friendly Group. That Group gains Rapid Drop and may launch Assets at the end of its activation while on the Max Thrust order until the end of the round.

Abilities.Name: Silent Killer
Abilities.Effect: When a friendly Group is given the Silent Running Order, that Group cannot gain Spikes due to your opponent's weapons, special rules, and Abilities until the end of the round.

Abilities.Name: Reaving Gaze
Abilities.Effect: When you assign a Group's weapons to a target, pick one of the attacking Group's Weapon Systems with "Oculus" in its name. That Weapon System replaces its Scald-X value with Reave-X+1 for that attack. If the attacking Group has 2 or more Ships, this Ability costs 2AP.

Abilities.Name: Dissipate Energy
Abilities.Effect: At the end of any Group's activation, target a friendly Group. Remove a Spike from the friendly Group.

Abilities.Name: Silent Launch
Abilities.Effect: When a friendly Group is given the Silent Running Order, that Group may use Launch Assets this round in addition to reducing its Signature to 0" until the start of its next activation.

Special: Attacks containing 7 or more Bombers cause Crippling-Fire to place a second Fire token on the target.
